summary: Republic Power Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from an extraordinary general meeting. The EGM approved a share repurchase where the company will repurchase 505,664 Class A shares from True Sage International Limited in exchange for issuing 505,664 new Class B shares. Shareholders also approved an amended memorandum and articles of association and authorized a potential share consolidation at a ratio between 1-for-2 and 1-for-100, to be determined by the board within 180 days. This filing is a routine corporate governance update and does not constitute a special situation event.
